name: hindi-prose
note: A name in running Hindi prose, with no field and no label — the case layer 1 cannot see and layer 3 could not read. Every other Indic fixture scored 100% with layer 3 detecting nothing at all in Devanagari, because their names all sit in labelled fields.

elements.why: given name + known surname in prose
honorific marks the person; surname deliberately NOT in the list, so only the honorific branch can catch it
DECOY: a department, not a person
DECOY: an office, with an organisation marker beside it
